# Intake review: <intake-id>

- Status: needs-clarification
- Selected solutions/agents: <stable identifiers>
- Source references and version evidence: <approved references or explicit unknowns>
- Classification and transfer approval: <destination and evidence>
- Account/tenant checkpoint: <verified or outstanding; no credentials>

## Scope and artifact inventory

List PRD, solution design, relevant decisions and additional applicable
readiness, identity, blueprint, value and FinOps material. Explain every
not-applicable declaration. Keep source and transformed baseline hashes distinct.

## Requirements and acceptance criteria

Record testable requirements, owners and acceptance criteria.

## Gaps and decisions

List unresolved items and whether they block acceptance.

## Review disposition

Record accepted, needs-clarification or rejected with human decision evidence.
An acquisition failure must be reported as an error, not an accepted record.

See the [manifest contract](../intake/README.md) for schema and validation.
